g.text: Drop into a codebase you’ve never seen and ask,
“where do we check the user’s session?”
An AI agent explores a living map of the code
and returns the exact files and lines, with
its search path drawn out for you to follow.
Python, BM25 and code embeddings, call graphs, React. Runs on a 4 GB laptop GPU.
Finds the right function on the first try
Tested on 74 real bug reports from the Express repo
